claim: For every Ψ in the 14+8 Schur coupling split, if D OR N is singular, the FULL 22×22 coupling matrix [[D,−J], [−J†,N]] is PSD. Thus the unrestricted T2 residual need only be proved for isometries with D>0, N>0 and J≠0, where its exact form is the ordinary inverse contraction ||D^(−1/2) J N^(−1/2)||≤1. No claim that this remaining inequality holds.
classification: D singular ⇒ its nonzero kernel x is a saturated block-diagonal pair. The UNREVIEWED classification says either σ2>σ3 and P is sector-diagonal (so parity-even, J=0), or one factor is rank-one and the other zero, forcing P=|v⟩⟨v|⊗Q or the swap with rank Q=2. N singular ⇒ offblocks are rank≤1; if both nonzero, the unique P is the sum of one Γ-even vector projector and one Γ-odd vector projector (J=0); if one zero, P is the same product form.
product_projector_proof: For arbitrary ORIGINAL traceless A,B and any rank-2 projector Q, P=|v⟩⟨v|⊗Q: letting a=⟨v,Av⟩ and b=Tr(QB), tracezero and three complementary A diagonal entries give ||A||²−||Av||²≥|a|²/3. Tracezero B and rank2 Q,I−Q give ||BQ||²≥|b|²/2 and ||B(I−Q)||²≥|b|²/2. The dual gap is at least (2/3)|a|²+(3/2)|b|²−2|ab|≥0 by AM-GM. Swap factors identically. This is valid for all original traceless matrices, not a selected state/q.
limits: No proof of the strictly-positive D,N,J≠0 contraction, global T2/T3/Z2/q3, η failure, physical counterexample, execution or novelty.
